title: Debug configuration
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Configuration for debug features: axis indicators, collision shape visualization, performance profiling, etc. Loaded from assets/config/debug.json with optional user overrides from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/delta-v-beyond-sector-3-26/debug.json per ADR-0010.

show_axis_indicators.description: Master switch for debug axis indicators (RGB arrows from entity origins). When true with empty axis_indicator_entities, show axes for ALL entities. When false, no axes are shown regardless of axis_indicator_entities.

axis_indicator_entities.description: Array of entity IDs to show debug axis indicators for. If empty and show_axis_indicators is true, axes are shown for all entities. If non-empty, axes are shown ONLY for these IDs (selective debugging). Use case: debug specific misaligned objects without visual clutter.

items.description: Entity ID (must match an id in the world definition)

show_collision_shapes.description: Master switch for collision shape visualization. When true, renders wireframe boxes/spheres around entities with collision shapes. Green = no collision, red = collision detected this frame.
